name: The crossing: rebuilt so she can follow every beat
body: Dean: the crossing fell apart because she couldn't follow. Every section is now one she can walk by beats: no pads, no gaps she would have to jump, doors and a bridge she and you hold for each other, the slot and the watcher hall.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: She follows every beat of the level end to end
The level completes only with her at the goal
